title: 银行支票记录去重
problem_statement_md:
在银行有一笔交易结束时，最终有6张支票(英文check)打印出来：
- 3张是银行的原件
- 3张是客户的副本

下图的操作记录表**Operation** 记录了该6张支票：

![](/content/assets/04dda43bede3b683e82c.jpeg)

请写一个查询，返回去重后的所有支票(列为`Checks`，大写).
problem_statement_en_md:
[s0l0!-header][h1]The DISTINCT Keyword[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

At the conclusion of a bank transaction, 6 checks are printed -- 3 originals for the bank, and 3 copies for the customer.
Here is the list of all the checks named [b]Operation[/b]:[img id="4466" width="100%"]
Write a query to show only the [b]unique checks[/b] that are given to the customer.
[note]Use the [b]DISTINCT[/b] statement to return the unique values of mentioned column.[/note]
hint_md: 使用**DISTINCT**语句来返回所列的唯一值。

code_templates.prepend_code:
CREATE TABLE Operation (
  id int,
  checks VARCHAR(128)
);

INSERT INTO Operation (id,checks)
VALUES
(1,'Check1'),
(2,'Check2'),
(3,'Check3'),
(4,'Check1'),
(5,'Check2'),
(6,'Check3');
